title: Noncommutative Abel-like identities
summary: We generalize the Abel--Hurwitz identities to an almost entirely noncommutative setting. Namely, let $V$ be a finite set of size $n$, and let $\mathbb{L}$ be any noncommutative ring. For each $s\in V$, let $x_{s}\in\mathbb{L}$. Set $x\left( S\right) :=\sum_{s\in S}x_{s}$ for any $S\subseteq V$. Let $X$ and $Y$ be two elements of $\mathbb{L}$ such that $X+Y$ lies in the center of $\mathbb{L}$. Then, we show that% \begin{align*} & \sum_{S\subseteq V}\left( X+x\left( S\right) \right) ^{\left\vert S\right\vert }\left( Y-x\left( S\right) \right) ^{n-\left\vert S\right\vert…
